name: Minifier HTML Source Output
description: Minifies the rendered HTML of every HtmlResponse (and inline CSS/JS within it) via regex on the kernel.response event; no configuration.
project_description: Minifier HTML is a performance-focused module that reduces the size of a page's rendered HTML output and compresses the inline CSS and JavaScript contained in that markup, with the goal of smaller payloads and faster load times. It registers a single kernel.response event subscriber that rewrites the body of each HTML response with regular expressions; it ships no routes, permissions, settings form, config or dependencies, and requires no configuration once enabled.
